record.question: A patient with Guillian Barre Syndrome is experiencing ascending weakness. Which of the following is the most common and critical complication that the nurse should monitor for?
record.explanation: Answer B: Respiratory failure. Guillain–Barré syndrome can progress to respiratory muscle weakness and failure; respiratory function is a critical monitoring priority. Reference: https://www.ninds.nih.gov/health-information/disorders/guillain-barre-syndrome. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
